name: Auth:SecretHigh
desc: Secret key (high word) for access control

name: Auth:SecretLow
desc: Secret key (low word) for access control

name: Speed:Min
desc: Minimum motor speed; below this motor stops

name: AnalogInput:Stop
desc: AI voltage below which motor stops

name: Failsafe:Mode
desc: Mode used when RS-485 communication is lost

name: Failsafe:Delay
desc: RS-485 silence time before failsafe activates

name: Journal:Skip
desc: Skip first N records in journal query (0 = skip nothing)

name: Journal:Read
desc: Journal read trigger; each set bit selects an event type (0xFFFF = everything)

name: Fault:Reset
desc: soft: reinit interfaces; hard: reboot both MCUs; fcty: hard reset and wipe stored config

name: AnalogInput:SensValue
desc: Converted sensor value (AI mapped via SensMin/Max; type per Mode)

name: Flow:Value
desc: Estimated volumetric flow; soft sensor from speed and power

name: MeasSlow:Freq
desc: Electrical output frequency; slow tier = calm display trend

name: MeasSlow:Speed
desc: Speed computed from frequency and Motor:Poles

name: MeasFast:Freq
desc: Electrical output frequency; fast tier = protection-grade filtering

name: MeasFast:Speed
desc: Speed computed from frequency and Motor:Poles

name: MeasNow:Freq
desc: Electrical output frequency; now tier = raw unfiltered values

name: MeasNow:Speed
desc: Speed computed from frequency and Motor:Poles

name: EstimSlow:Angle
desc: Electrical rotor angle estimate; full turn = 65536

name: EstimFast:Angle
desc: Electrical rotor angle estimate; full turn = 65536

name: EstimNow:Angle
desc: Electrical rotor angle estimate; full turn = 65536

name: Speed:DerateTemp
desc: Temperature above which speed is derated down to Speed:Derating

name: Speed:DerateCurr
desc: Current above which speed is derated down to Speed:Derating

name: Thresh:CurrRms
desc: RMS current threshold for emergency shutdown

name: Thresh:CurrPeak
desc: Peak current threshold for emergency shutdown

name: Thresh:PeakCount
desc: Peak overcurrent events tolerated before the fault trips

name: Thresh:StartFreq
desc: Correction mechanisms stay off below this frequency

name: AnalogInput:Mode
desc: Analog input function (sens_u16/i16 raw type; flow overrides Flow LUT)

name: AnalogInput:SensMin
desc: Raw value at AnalogInput:Min voltage (type per Mode; no scale)

name: AnalogInput:SensMax
desc: Raw value at AnalogInput:Max voltage (type per Mode; no scale)

name: Fault:RetryDelay
desc: Extra delay after braking before auto-retry (min 1s enforced)

name: Fault:RetryTimeout
desc: Fault-free time to reset retry counter

name: Ctrl:BootDelay
desc: Stabilization delay after DC bus reaches Thresh:DcBusMin

name: Motor:Invert
desc: Swap phase sequence UVW to UWV; reverses rotation direction

name: Pwm:InitFreq
desc: Starting frequency for initial rotor alignment

name: Pwm:ClampShort
desc: Short-pulse suppression in PWM timer counts [0:off]

name: Ramp:UpdateN
desc: Frequency step every N PWM cycles

name: Ramp:RiseDeltaBend
desc: Bend for acceleration slew rate curve

name: Ramp:FallDeltaBend
desc: Bend for deceleration slew rate curve

name: Brake:TimeStop
desc: Coasting time before restart at maximum frequency

name: Brake:StartDelay
desc: Static-vector rotor alignment before acceleration begins; PWM holds a frozen phase so the rotor settles at a known angle

name: MeasCfg:Window
desc: Current and bus window length in samples; RMS/peak/ripple close once per window

name: MeasCfg:SchmittMin
desc: Zero-crossing hysteresis floor [ADC counts]; rejects idle noise

name: MeasCfg:SchmittDiv
desc: Zero-crossing hysteresis divider; threshold = window peak-to-peak / div

name: MeasCfg:HampelScale
desc: Global Hampel threshold multiplier [0:spike filter off]

name: MeasCfg:ScalarFast
desc: Fast tier EMA shift for voltages and temperatures; tau = 2^n samples at 10kHz

name: MeasCfg:ScalarSlow
desc: Slow tier EMA shift for voltages and temperatures

name: MeasCfg:WindowFast
desc: Fast tier EMA shift for currents/peaks/ripple; tau = 2^n windows

name: MeasCfg:WindowSlow
desc: Slow tier EMA shift for currents/peaks/ripple

name: Const:TempA
desc: Linear temp sensor slope: T = A × V_adc + B (linear sensor variant only)

name: Const:TempB
desc: Linear temp sensor offset: T = A × V_adc + B (linear sensor variant only)

name: Adapt:Enable
desc: Adaptation enable bits; every mechanism is off by default

name: Adapt:CurrLimitStop
desc: Current limit at Adapt:StopFreq; must stay below the current at which the hardware peak comparator fires

name: Adapt:CurrLimitBend
desc: Bend for current limit curve [>0: limit rises to Stop quickly at low freq]

name: Adapt:CurrHyst
desc: Current gate release hysteresis below Adapt:CurrLimit

name: Adapt:VdcLow
desc: DC-bus voltage below which acceleration ramp is stretched (see Adapt:VdcHigh)

name: Adapt:VdcHigh
desc: DC-bus voltage above which deceleration ramp is stretched (see Adapt:VdcLow)

name: Adapt:ExciteStart
desc: Reactive current reference at 0Hz for the excitation trim

name: Adapt:ExciteBend
desc: Bend for the reactive current reference curve

name: Stall:StopFreq
desc: Locked-rotor detection disabled above this frequency (also bend x_max) [0:off]

name: Stall:Bend
desc: Bend for stall current threshold curve

name: Debug:RiseDelta
desc: Acceleration slew rate at current frequency

name: Debug:FallDelta
desc: Deceleration slew rate at current frequency

name: Debug:UpdateN
desc: Effective ramp update interval in PWM cycles

name: Debug:PeakCount
desc: Peak overcurrent events since last clear

name: Debug:ModTrim
desc: Total modulation correction applied by the adaptation mechanisms

name: Debug:FoldTrim
desc: Modulation correction from the current foldback

name: Debug:ExciteTrim
desc: Modulation correction from the excitation trim

name: Debug:DampTrim
desc: Modulation correction from the hunting damper

name: Journal:Count
desc: Number of records returned by last Journal:Read (0..32)
